description: Change what someone may do in this workspace. Owners and admins can manage forms, responses, integrations, and credentials; members cannot. This changes who has authority over everything in here, so ASK THE HUMAN FIRST and pass confirm=true only once they agree. You can never grant a role above the acting person's own. Identify the member by id or email from fillo_list_members. Needs members:manage.

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after the human has approved this action. Ask them first and quote what it will do — never set this on your own initiative.

member.description: Member id or email from fillo_list_members.

name: fillo_change_member_role
title: Change a member's role
